comment: What scripts/oss/export-public.mjs may put in a public candidate tree. A committed path is exported only when it matches an include entry, matches no exclude entry / excluded name / forbidden type, and — for media — is explicitly allowed. Entries ending in / are folders; no globs. docs/ is never included wholesale: each public document is named. Changing this file is a publication decision; review it like code (PUBLIC_EXPORT.md).
